fullContentHtml:
Short Information : CSIR-Indian Institute of Toxicology Research, IITR, Lucknow has released the notification for the post of Junior Stenographer. This recruitment has been issued for 04 posts. Online applying process for CSIR IITR Junior Stenographer Recruitment 2025 has started from 07 May 2025 & the candidates can apply till 31 May 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for CSIR IITR Junior Stenographer Recruitment 2025 which has given below. 

CSIR-Indian Institute of Toxicology Research, IITR, Lucknow

CSIR IITR Junior Stenographer Recruitment 2025

CSIR Advt No. : IITR/02/2025

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 May 2025
  • Last Date : 31 May 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 May 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

CSIR IITR Junior Stenographer Notification 2025 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 31 May 2025
  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age : 27 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per CSIR IITR Junior Stenographer Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

CSIR IITR Junior Stenographer Recruitment 2025 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates who have completed their Intermediate/ Class 12th level of examination from a recognized board in India.
  • Proficiency in Stenographer (English / Hindi).
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.
